Hearth uses open-source software. Thank you to its authors.

Noise suppression
-----------------
Hearth's noise suppression uses nnnoiseless, a Rust version of RNNoise.
RNNoise: Copyright (c) Xiph.Org Foundation, Mozilla, Jean-Marc Valin and contributors.
nnnoiseless: Copyright (c) Joe Neeman and contributors.
Both are distributed under the BSD 3-Clause License:

DeepFilterNet noise suppression
-------------------------------
Hearth's stronger noise suppression runs the DeepFilterNet3 model
(https://github.com/Rikorose/DeepFilterNet, Copyright (c) Hendrik Schröter and contributors)
through deep-filter-rt (https://gitlab.com/chpio/voice-filter), which includes the model,
and the tract neural-network runner (Copyright (c) Sonos, Inc. and contributors).
All are distributed under the MIT License and/or the Apache License 2.0.

Other libraries
---------------
The window and drawing (egui/eframe), sound (cpal), screen capture (xcap),
camera (nokhwa), pictures (image), networking (ureq), zip files (zip),
checksums (sha2), dates (chrono) and data files (serde, serde_json) come from
open-source Rust libraries published under the MIT and/or Apache-2.0 licences.
